demo.program:
# ReasonML — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created ReasonML?", "Facebook"),
    ("What paradigm is ReasonML?", "functional + OOP"),
    ("What is creator?", "Facebook"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "2016"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "functional + OOP"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".re"),
    ("What is hello world?", "Js.log(\"Hello, world!\");"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
